decisive_spans: exploratory laparotomy “showed no mechanical cause of the obstructions”

response.rationale: The vignette describes recurrent obstructive symptoms without a mechanical cause, along with bowel dilation on imaging, which is classic for intestinal pseudo-obstruction. Short bowel syndrome would require a history of extensive bowel resection, which is absent. The presence of fat-soluble vitamin deficiencies and weight loss are secondary to the motility disorder and malabsorption, not indicative of short bowel syndrome.

rejected.why: No history of bowel resection; the clinical picture is dominated by pseudo-obstruction rather than short bowel syndrome.
